# owner: platform
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _absent_days(student, marks):
    days = []
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError("mark for another student")
        if mark.status == "absent":
            days.append(mark.day)
    return sorted(days)


# ---
def build_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]):
    days = _absent_days(student, marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    dates = ", ".join(when.isoformat() for when in days)
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return f"{name} missed {len(days)} day(s): {dates}."
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")


def _mark(ident, when, status):
    return Mark(ident, when, status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            _mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
            _mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 4), "present"),
            _mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent"),
        ]
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertEqual(
            text,
            "Jane Doe missed 2 day(s): 2026-03-02, 2026-03-05.",
        )

    def test_other_student_raises(self):
        marks = [_mark("s2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        marks = [_mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
EOF
